Alive.note: A dead Townsfolk the Professor brings back to life.

No Ability.note: On the Professor after they use their ability.

setupPrep.none: its tokens are only used after the first night or when something happens

reminderMovement.why: Marks that this character has used its once-per-game ability.

reminderPlaceholders.note: A resurrected Townsfolk; the ability is used either way.

full.text: The Professor might choose a dead player. If they do, mark the Professor *NO ABILITY*. If that player is a Townsfolk, they are resurrected: mark them *ALIVE*.
full.reason: Says which token goes on whom.
